codeReview.summary: The fix adequately resolves the prior blocking startup regression. `main.py` now loads dotenv before importing `agent.auth`, and JWT/Fernet secret resolution in `agent/auth.py` is lazy at call time, so importing `agent.auth` no longer fails when `JWT_SECRET_KEY` is not pre-exported.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared environment docs are stale after this fix: they still describe JWT secret usage as import-time and requiring pre-import availability.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/environment.md:20 says `JWT_SECRET_KEY` is used by `agent/auth.py (import-time)` and must be available before importing auth, but `agent/auth.py:25` now uses lazy `_get_jwt_secret()` and `main.py:7` loads dotenv before `from agent.auth ...` at `main.py:15`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission coding convention and implemented bootstrap pattern are now in tension; an explicit exception for early dotenv bootstrap would reduce ambiguity.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Mission AGENTS.md:29 requires all imports grouped at top, while `main.py` intentionally executes `load_dotenv()` at line 7 before later imports to satisfy auth secret initialization ordering.

summary: Fix review passed. The commit directly addresses the original failure from `fix-jwt-default-secret` by eliminating import-time JWT secret enforcement and ensuring dotenv is loaded before auth import, with no new blocking issues found.
